claims.claim: The proposal funds 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support rather than building a new wallet product.
The requested 1,310,960 ada consists of 1,272,777 ada for hardware wallet maintenance and compatibility assurance plus a 38,183 ada Intersect budget administration fee.

Continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk for a security-critical access layer.
Funding continuity in 2026 is less costly and less disruptive than waiting for accumulated breakage that could cause users or integrators to lose access.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract.
Oversight will involve Intersect admin and leadership roles plus six external entities: Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi will allow community audit and tracking of withdrawn ada and related metrics, with activity immutably verifiable on chain.
Prior treasury funding related to hardware wallets, Ledger app work, Plutus enhancement, and several Project Catalyst items is disclosed through linked governance action and Catalyst URLs.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for 2026 hardware-wallet maintenance, routed through Intersect-administered smart contracts with external oversight, and presents the proposal as continuity funding for a security-critical Cardano access layer with Intersect budget-process approval and NCL compliance.
